questions.q: What problem does an AutoPost criteria set solve?
options: It fixes unbalanced journals automatically
It approves journals that need human sign-off
It lets General Ledger post matching, trusted, routine batches automatically without a manual click
It imports journals from a spreadsheet
questions.explain: AutoPost criteria sets automate posting for batches that match defined, trusted criteria, removing manual friction.

questions.q: Which four attributes can an AutoPost criteria set combine?
options: Ledger, legal entity, business unit, currency
Preparer, approver, amount, and account
Chart of accounts, calendar, currency, accounting method
Journal source, journal category, balance type, and period
questions.explain: A criteria set is defined by source, category, balance type, and period (or date range).

questions.q: What does 'priority' control when multiple AutoPost criteria sets exist?
options: Which criteria set is evaluated first when more than one could apply to the same batch
Which journal gets approved first
Which ledger posts first
Which user can create a criteria set
questions.explain: Priority determines the evaluation order among multiple criteria sets that might otherwise both match.

questions.q: Why is AutoPost a poor fit for one-off manual adjustment journals?
options: AutoPost cannot technically process Manual-source journals at all
Those journals are exactly the kind a controller wants to review before they change a balance, unlike predictable, already-trusted routine journals
Manual journals are always unbalanced
AutoPost only works with foreign currency journals
questions.explain: AutoPost suits predictable, already-trusted journals; one-off adjustments typically warrant a human review before posting.

questions.q: In the lesson's example, what caused Solara Fixtures' monthly allocation batch to post automatically?
options: A controller manually clicked Post
It was imported via FBDI
It was flagged for auto-reverse
It matched a criteria set (source Allocation, category Allocation, balance type Actual) and validated cleanly
questions.explain: The batch matched the defined criteria set's source, category, and balance type, triggering automatic posting.
